notes.title: A lot of emotions without a word! 😺❤️
notes.notes:

👁️ From the start, we wanted our game to not just tell a story but make you feel it. We thought about how to show what our characters are feeling without using words. That's where the visual feedback comes in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43995652/d4b1c93722c5a530cef641ba9d28e2d8c898426e.gif[/img]

notes.title: Open your ears, sound is here! 🔈🙀
notes.notes:
🔈Greetings, fellow cat lovers! 🔈We're thrilled to share an exciting update on the progress of our latest project. Today, we dive into the realm of audio, where every echo, footstep, and meow adds a layer of depth to our game, making it truly come alive.

As we all know, sound plays a pivotal role in enhancing the gaming experience. It's the subtle rustle of leaves in a dense forest, the distant hum of machinery, or the intense music that kicks in during a critical moment that can send shivers down your spine. These auditory elements contribute significantly to the overall immersion, making the virtual world feel tangible and real.

Our dedicated audio designers has been hard at work, meticulously crafting the soundscape for our game. From the smallest details like the little cat steps to the thunderous loudspeakers, every sound is being carefully chosen and implemented to create a rich and dynamic environment.

Without further ado, let us provide you with a sneak peek into what's brewing in our sound lab. Imagine wandering through a dense, mysterious forest—the leaves crunching beneath your feet, birds singing overhead, and the wind gently whispering through the trees. Each step you take is accompanied by the authentic sound of the terrain beneath you, drawing you deeper into the heart of the virtual world.

[previewyoutube=8psuav7seS4;full][/previewyoutube]
What's Next?

As we continue refining and expanding our game's audio landscape, we invite you to stay tuned for further updates. The immersive experience we're building is not just about stunning visuals but about enveloping you in a world that feels tangible and alive in every sense.

In the coming weeks, we'll be sharing more behind-the-scenes glimpses of our sound design process, showcasing the dedication and creativity that goes into making our game.

notes.title: Physics are here! ⬇️⚽
notes.notes:
Our team has embarked on an exciting journey to enhance our project by incorporating more physics-based interactions. This move promises to infuse our game world with fresh, unpredictable outcomes. In this blog post, we'll take you through the thrilling process of introducing controlled chaos into our gaming universe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43995652/d2406419d05b495429ccc95d77822040ca73e92d.gif[/img]

Dynamic environments react to player actions create more interactive and engaging experiences. From pushing objects to making things fall from edges, physics-based interactions enrich the game world.

One of the most intriguing aspects of physics-based interactions is the element of chaos. This controlled chaos adds moments of brilliance, comedy, or awe that scripted events can't replicate. For example, a player solving a puzzle by stacking boxes may accidentally create an entirely unforeseen but functional solution, leading to emergent, entertaining moments.

As we continue to develop our game with a focus on physics-based interactions, we're embracing unpredictability and creative potential. By allowing players to shape their own experiences, we're eager to witness the unscripted magic, laughter, and awe that physics systems can bring.

✨🐱 Stay tuned for more character design process by following our updates and joining us on social media. Don't miss a single twist or turn as we unfold the tale of Domino and the old man. Coming for PC and consoles! 👴🏻✨

notes.title: Unleashing Real-Time Object Interaction 🏐📦
notes.notes:
We're excited to introduce a game-changing mechanic to Domino's adventure - real-time physics-based object interaction. Now, Domino can grab and manipulate objects in the game world, all governed by realistic physics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43995652/45cff7808864bd005375a517b71797ce232709d5.gif[/img]

Picture Domino toppling stacks of blocks or pushing them all around the level, making objects react dynamically to her every move. These interactions aren't just scripted animations - they're responsive to Domino's actions in real time.

This mechanic opens up a world of possibilities: clearing paths, solving physics-based puzzles, and adding an entirely new layer of immersion to the game. Get ready to see Domino's world come to life as she sends objects rolling, flying, and tumbling, creating a thrilling and engaging gameplay experience like never before.

notes.title: ⬆️ Jump up: Improving How Domino Moves in the Game 🐈
notes.notes:
In our development journey, we're excited to share the latest news about Domino's movements, making smoother and more fun.

🔃[b]Making Direction Changes Better:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43995652/d43fe0b003fc09edd5a084ce912f765b7408744e.gif[/img]

One important thing in our game is how Domino moves in different directions. We want players to feel like they have full control. So, we're working on making it easier to turn, speed up, and slow down. This way, when you change directions, it will feel natural and not like a sudden, jarring move.

🦘[b]Making Jumps Look and Feel Good:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43995652/46e1196c44d67a98e203e938d17e8900fd334e89.gif[/img]

We're working to make jumping in the game feel just right, adjusting how high the player can jump so it's not too high or too low. We're also making sure the way the jump animations looks fluent and lifelike. Whether it's jumping high or doing quick jumps, we want it to be fun and look great!

👂🏻[b]Listening to Feedback:[/b]

We believe that collaboration and feedback are the driving forces behind creating a memorable gaming experience. That's why we place immense value on the input gathered from our dedicated development group.

Regular meetings and group feedback sessions have become an integral part of our development process. The team carefully listens to the insights, suggestions, and critiques provided by our group members and incorporates them into each iteration of the game. This iterative approach ensures that Domino's movement is not just refined but also aligns perfectly with the expectations and preferences of our future players.

☝🏻[b]Conclusion:[/b]

Our goal is to create a game where controlling Domino feels amazing. We're constantly working on making her movements smoother and more enjoyable, from changing directions to jumping. We're grateful for the feedback we receive, and we can't wait to share our game with you. Together, we'll go on adventures with our agile and graceful cat character.

notes.title: ✏️ Charatcer design series: Montserrat 🐟
notes.notes:
Welcome back to our game development blog! Today, we're excited to share the design process of one of our beloved characters, Montserrat, the resilient and indomitable fishmonger who keeps the heart of our town's market beating.

Montserrat is a local woman who resides in the same charming town as Domino and Hooman. She plays a crucial role in the town's market, ensuring that it thrives day in and day out. Her story is one of determination, strength, and unwavering commitment to her family and community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43995652/cd1a140e39841955d34b34f9de3ad8f0850344fd.png[/img]

After her husband's unexpected departure, Montserrat found herself facing the daunting task of single-handedly raising their daughter (which will be revealed soon!). With grit and determination, she decided to take the reins of the family market. From the early hours of dawn until late into the night, she tirelessly oversees every aspect of the market's operation. Montserrat's dedication has earned her the profound respect and admiration of her community.

While creating Montserrat's character, we sought to encapsulate her rich personality and backstory into her visual design. Our character artists explored numerous shapes, aiming to craft a character whose appearance resonates with her compelling narrative.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43995652/1a9a925caab08d25d48f0e1dddb4e8de6f8f748f.gif[/img]

Creating Montserrat's design was only the first step; the next was bringing her to life in the game. Through intricate animations and interactions, we ensure that her character evolves as players engage with her. Whether she's briskly attending to customers or scaring away any cat (Domino, yes) that tries to steal fish from the market, Montserrat's actions reflect her multifaceted personality.

We hope Montserrat will become a cherished character in our game, resonating with players as they uncover her story and explore the depths of her character.

notes.title: ✏️ Charatcer design series: Salvador 🕊️
notes.notes:
Today, we're excited to show you another of our character concept and design process, with a focus on one of the most mischievous and unpredictable figures in our game's universe: Salvador, the evil seagull.

[h1]The Character[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43995652/dd7ac489bf88452f6ce962322fe31d32ccaffc1b.gif[/img]

Salvador's design wasn't difficult, as most of the team grew up next to the Mediterranean coast, where chaotic scenes from seagulls can be seen every day in real life. 

With a penchant for chaos and an insatiable obsession with food, Salvador is the ultimate thorn in the side of our protagonist, Domino. In this blog post, we'll walk you through the fascinating journey of bringing Salvador to life, exploring the various shapes and designs we considered to capture his unique personality.

Much like Domino, Salvador grew up in the same coastal environment. However, unlike our brave heroine, Salvador's life took a rather chaotic turn from a very young age. He terrorized the coastal town, leaving a trail of chaos and food-related incidents in his wake. And guess what? He's still at it, stirring up trouble to this very day.

His primary goal in life is as simple as it is troublesome: to devour as much food as possible, with no regard for the consequences. This insatiable hunger often leads him into confrontations with anything and anyone that stands between him and his next meal. Moreover, Salvador possesses a temperament that can only be described as explosive. Any situation can spiral into pandemonium within seconds when Salvador is around.

But here's the intriguing twist in Salvador's character: despite his chaotic behavior towards others, he has a soft spot for his own kind. Salvador is always on the lookout for smaller seagulls that might be in danger, protecting them with an unexpected sense of responsibility.

[h1]The Design Process[/h1]

We wanted to craft a character whose appearance instantly conveyed his personality and role in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43995652/6accfcdba9b8477061f02d6c0aa15329d21907e4.png[/img]

Our first step was to explore various shapes for Salvador. We experimented with different body sizes, wing configurations, and beak shapes to find the perfect match for his chaotic and gluttonous nature. We considered sleek and menacing designs as well as more comical and exaggerated options to strike the right balance.

Salvador's personality is all about contradictions: chaos and protectiveness, hunger and loyalty. We incorporated these elements into his design by giving him a disheveled appearance, with feathers ruffled from countless food-related skirmishes. His eyes hold a mischievous glint, hinting at his love for mayhem.

Salvador, the evil seagull, is a character that embodies the spirit of chaos, gluttony, and unpredictability. Through a meticulous design process that explored various shapes and details, we've brought this character to life in a way that we believe will captivate and challenge players throughout the game.

notes.title: ✏️ Charatcer design series: Hooman 👴🏻
notes.notes:
Welcome back to our game devblog! Today, we're thrilled to dive into the character concept and design process of Hooman, the second main character in our upcoming game. Hooman's journey from grumpiness to newfound joy is a central element of our game's narrative, and his design needed to reflect his complex personality and emotional dynamics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43995652/e6e80df3b4edbae216e4561ec80e2bf5fa27abf5.png[/img]

[b]Character Description[/b]

Hooman is an old and grumpy man who recently became a widower. He may not seem like the friendliest person at first glance, but beneath his stern exterior lies a vulnerable soul. His character design must convey this duality effectively.

[b]Backstory[/b]

Hooman's backstory plays a crucial role in shaping his character design. Born and raised on the sunny shores of the Mediterranean Sea, he spent over five decades working at the local waterworks. This job made him a stern and serious individual who often pushed people away. However, his soft spot for his late wife, Georgina, and his challenging relationship with his daughter, Olivia, offer a glimpse into his more tender side.

[b]Exploring Shapes and Personality[/b]

To create a visual representation of Hooman, our design team explored various shapes and visual elements. We wanted to find a balance that reflected both his gruff exterior and his inner vulnerability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43995652/19c561f38c1835726a0d475686cc0907dccee9fb.png[/img]

[b]Emotional Dynamics and Transformation[/b]

Hooman's character design is not static; it is a reflection of his emotional transformation throughout the game. Initially grumpy and isolated, he gradually learns the importance of patience and kindness through his interactions with Domino the cat. His character design will evolve to mirror this emotional journey, with subtle changes in his emotions as he becomes more open and expressive.

[b]Social Isolation[/b]

Hooman's preference for solitude and his gruff exterior are evident in his character design. He will be portrayed as someone who doesn't readily engage with others, making his eventual transformation all the more powerful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43995652/72e2e9c0c03fdf00399886a7e478133254415d10.png[/img]

In conclusion, Hooman's character design is a careful blend of visual elements that reflect his grumpy exterior and inner vulnerability. As players embark on his emotional journey in our game, they will witness a transformation not only in his personality but also in his visual representation. 

✨🐱  Stay tuned for more character design process by following our updates and joining us on social media. Don't miss a single twist or turn as we unfold the tale of Domino and the old man. Coming for PC and consoles! 👴🏻✨

Domino is like that friend who's always up for a tasty treat and can't help but spread good vibes. We've been busy drawing and brainstorming to create a character that feels just right for our game. We played around with round shapes that felt as cozy as your favourite pastry. We also tried longer and elegant shapes that reminded us of a cat strolling through a bakery. But it didn't click until we found the perfect blend – a mix of round and active that shows her food-loving but active personality.

notes.title: 🐈 From Stray to Belonging 👴🏻
notes.notes:
😺 Life had not always been as comfortable and secure for Domino. Before fate intervened and brought the old man into her life, Domino had been a stray cat, wandering the streets of the town all on her own.

Domino roamed freely, exploring the hidden nooks and crannies of the ancient alleyways. She relied on her instincts and agile nature to survive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43995652/99f36141d0e353128bb20145119dffd9b0ae0c51.gif[/img]

But deep down, she longed for a gentle touch, a warm lap to curl up on, and a loving presence to call her own. Her heart ached for connection, and she often wondered if she would ever find a place where she truly belonged.

Little did Domino know that her solitary existence was about to be transformed forever. The old man, with a heart still pumping for his late wife, was soon to cross paths with the stray cat, and their destinies would intertwine in the most loving way.

🌊 For The Old Man and His Cat, we decided to set the game in a charming town near the shores of the Mediterranean Sea.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43995652/4bcfd5f95094f965e473bcdcdf38ebc163693221.gif[/img]

 🌞 Our inspiration comes from the captivating beauty of the Mediterranean coastline, where most of our team is located or grew up. Imagine narrow cobblestone streets lined with vibrant houses adorned with plants while the scent of salty sea air fills the atmosphere.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43995652/4e8f2a9335bc20b570136c827181b74a69b0b359.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43995652/19a72c02f6e90f04514063ae6172303dba478715.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43995652/b6664fe77ec1fabeff50f87d401a9e6c14935fc4.png[/img]

🏘️ As players navigate through the town, they will encounter various locations, each with its own distinct charm. From the small town's cove to the interior of the local houses, every corner of the town holds its own secrets and surprises.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43995652/972ea60913b34c134673fe4cbabd1d189dbb1256.jpg[/img]

🧡 The main pillar of the game is a heartwarming story that follows the journey of a stray cat and an old man and the town serves as a backdrop for their adventures, creating a warm and immersive experience for players to enjoy.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43995652/c0b59f9c1c0d8e0d1cc6181648438ac1dd66984f.jpg[/img]

🆕 We are excited to share more about this upcoming video game as its development progresses. Follow our social media channels and website for the latest news, concept art reveals, and behind-the-scenes insights. 

🐈 Join us as we embark on this journey together, exploring the beauty of the Mediterranean and the heartwarming connection between a cat and an old man. Stay tuned for more updates as we bring this town to life. We can't wait to share this unforgettable experience with you all! -

notes.title: 😼 Domino enters the scene!
notes.notes:
😼 Meet Domino, the main character of the story! She is a stray cat with a big love for food that wanders into the life of a lonely old man and quickly becomes his faithful companion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43995652/ef8cc163e3856acbb0845a450f600bc4cffaf79f.png[/img]

🌞 She grew up in the streets of a very small town in the Mediterranean, so even if some threats appeared throughout her life, she managed to survive until then. 

🐈 Even though her shape is round and compact, we are working on making her movement and animations fluid and smooth (she's still a cat, and everyone knows cats are in a constant liquid state).

notes.title: New stories, new bonds, new friends 🐱👴🏻
notes.notes:
Introducing Playstark’s last project [b]"The Old Man and His Cat"[/b] – A beautiful story about a stray cat helping a lonely old man find happiness again.

[h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43995652/c05fb9ce577e7aaa5b86cb6f863e30c82ccf8984.gif[/img][/h1]

The game follows the story of Domino, a stray cat meeting a lonely old man, and thanks to his kindness, decides to help him to achieve happiness again after the passing away of his lovely wife. 

The game is aimed to be a calm experience, encouraging players to take their time to explore the beautiful environments, interact with the world around them, solve puzzles and discover a small but charming story told through its gameplay and visuals.

Our dev team is gearing up to share the progress updates on our social media channels. Stay tuned for a sneak peek into our development process!
